answers.core: It seems to me this is a core issue, but i would also be happy with an add-on or other solutions.
answers.workaround: I'm actually using static Sprite3D so in my case a simple workaround is to use 2 sprites, one for the shaded albedo and one unshaded with the emission texture used as albedo, but it's not a good solution especially because i'll probably add small animations to the sprites, and definitively it's not good at all for meshes.

title: Make the emission visible outside of the albedo visible area
